facts.fact: Connecting Africa states the DARE1 submarine cable has been operational since 2021, linking Djibouti City, Bosaso and Mogadishu in Somalia and Mombasa, Kenya, with 36 Tbit/s over three fibre pairs.

systems.owner: Djibouti Telecom (partners Hormuud Telecom, Somtel International, Telkom Kenya)
